title: Mission Source Priority Index
boundary: The site prioritizes top relevant evidence lanes for its mission. It does not claim to ingest every record. Priority is based on ability to prove, disprove or materially clarify control-route claims.

priorities.title: SEC EDGAR / ownership / proxy-vote records
priorities.mission: Best lane for asset managers, BlackRock/Vanguard/State Street, holdings, voting power, mandates and ownership claims.
disproves: viral claims that confuse fund holdings with direct secret ownership

priorities.title: Government contracts and procurement records
priorities.mission: Best lane for contractors, public money, operational outsourcing and state/private execution routes.
disproves: claims without contract numbers or agency records

priorities.title: Court dockets, exhibits and enforcement records
priorities.mission: Best lane for wrongdoing, litigation, sworn exhibits, settlements, indictments and Epstein-related court trails.

priorities.title: Central-bank, BIS, IMF and digital-money records
priorities.mission: Best lane for currency convergence, CBDC, settlement, programmable payment and monetary-control routes.
disproves: claims that leap from discussion paper to completed world currency

priorities.title: Epstein-file court and source-document lane
priorities.mission: Best lane for Epstein-related claims when tied to court records, official releases, exhibits and named-source trails.
disproves: unsupported name-list claims or decontextualized screenshots

priorities.title: UN / WHO / EU / NATO / G20 / public-policy records
priorities.mission: Best lane for governance convergence, treaties, standards, emergency frameworks and policy coordination.
disproves: claims that every coordination document equals one hidden government

priorities.title: Charity, foundation and NGO registry records
priorities.mission: Best lane for foundations, family routes, religious networks, NGOs, funding and institutional influence.

priorities.title: Lobbying, donations and public influence records
priorities.mission: Best lane for policy influence, revolving doors, think tanks and legislative pressure.
disproves: influence claims without money or meeting records

priorities.title: Major media and wire-source document lane
priorities.mission: Best lane for discovery and timeline building, but should be upgraded with primary documents.
disproves: nothing alone; media is a lead unless supported by records

priorities.title: WikiLeaks / document-archive lead lane
priorities.mission: Useful discovery lane for cables, emails and document dumps when authenticated and cross-checked.

priorities.title: Viral video and screenshot claim lane
priorities.mission: Useful lead lane for reader questions and claim triage, not a proof lane by itself.
disproves: unsupported viral interpretation when records do not match
